groups.problem: Storage Create and Update failures are recorded using the legacy duration metric.
groups.rationale: These suggestions identify the same incorrect recorder copied into two storage error paths. Both locations require replacing recordLegacyDuration with recordStorageDuration; S6 explicitly covers both occurrences.

groups.problem: The successful Delete metric uses the object name instead of options.Kind for its kind label.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same argument at line 106. Label inconsistency, high cardinality and broken aggregation are consequences of that single mistake.

groups.problem: The asynchronous legacy operations inherit request cancellation through their timeout contexts.
groups.rationale: All three report the same context-parent mistake across Create, Delete, Update and DeleteCollection. Each recommends detaching request cancellation before applying the timeout.

groups.problem: Legacy DeleteCollection duration and errors are recorded using the storage metric.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same incorrect recordStorageDuration call at line 166 and recommend recordLegacyDuration.

groups.problem: Legacy Update receives the original objInfo instead of a wrapper containing the object returned by Storage.Update.
groups.rationale: All three describe recomputing the update against legacy state and the resulting potential divergence. Restoring the wrapper around res resolves every report.

groups.problem: Delete places d.Log in the context instead of the enriched per-call logger.
groups.rationale: Both identify the logger choice at line 97, which drops the name, kind and method context fields.
